meta.name: browser-use
meta.description: Direct browser control via CDP for web interaction: automation, scraping, testing, screenshots, and site/app work.

copy.tagline: 用代码直接操控浏览器完成网页自动化操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用脚本控制浏览器执行点击、填表、截图等操作
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser programmatically for web automation and testing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script browser actions like clicking, form filling, and screenshots

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能直接控制浏览器，自动打开网页、点击、截图、填写表单、提取信息，还能同时运行多个浏览器任务。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 操作网页（如自动填表、抓取数据、测试网站）时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开百度，搜索“天气”，截图搜索结果。
同时打开三个网页，分别截图首页。
say.note: Claude 会建议使用云端浏览器并行执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can directly control a browser: open pages, click, take screenshots, fill forms, extract data, and run multiple browser tasks concurrently.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to interact with a web page, such as auto-filling forms, scraping data, or testing a site.

say_en.text: Open Baidu, search for 'weather', and screenshot the results.
Open three web pages simultaneously and screenshot each homepage.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest using cloud browsers for parallel execution.
